statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The diagnosis codes are I48.0 and I49.9
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
